title: 第5章 骑士与骑士第6章 最伟大的骑士
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 第5章骑士与骑士
唐大概率不是人贩，那自己又是被谁给盯上了？
姆莉想来想去，能怀疑的人只有花店的店长了。
可店长那么好的人会是坏人吗？姆莉不愿相信，可店长送了她一盆灵匣子，正好能够对应唐之前所说的送花……
“唐，你是怎么找到我们的？”姆莉趁机询问唐。
“哦？这要多亏这家伙了。”唐手指脚边跟随的黑犬，此时对方如同大胜，步伐得意。
唐开始解释自己这段时间的作为：
通过不断调查发现失踪者都接受过他人赠花，将此事告知骑士团却未有调查结果反而被骑士团警告不要谎报线索。
于是自作主张借告白之名赠花，以寻线索，后来发现收到过气味覆盖能力强的花的女性没有遭遇绑架。
“在多次尝试后我便确定此事，找了镇上的训狗人，恰好听说这段时间经常有人租用猎犬。”
姆莉听完心惊，原来唐送花表白是为了这样吗？真不是为了求爱？
“呃……所以，你告白真的从没成功过？”
“成功过，但我反悔了，伤了人家的自尊，之后还需向她们解释清楚。”
“也就是说，你从没想过找一个恋人？”姆莉感觉自己有些八卦了。
“怎么会？成为最伟大的骑士，一定要有一位恋人，不过我不想用这种办法邂逅爱情。”唐解释，他虽告白是假，但想要恋人是真。
姆莉一时竟不知如何评价，于是又将话题引回。
“你是怎么用猎犬找到我们的？”
“它脱缰就跑，在花店门口嗅灵匣子，它看我过来，转头就带我追到了这里。”
唐的语气轻松直接，可姆莉却听得一身冷汗。
灵匣子？那个温雅的店长竟真是人贩？！幸亏自己遇见了唐……
“灵匣子？你们说那个流光溢彩的花吗？”一位少女插入了话题。
“也有人给我送过同样的花！”一位女士惊讶。
“我们回去就向骑士团举报那人！”
“对！太可恶了！”
不久回镇，妇女们还未入镇门就被大量骑士围住，吓得姆莉赶紧出言解释。
原来有人半夜发现她们失踪便汇报给骑士团，骑士团一直找到天明，此刻既兴奋又疲惫，一时脑袋糊涂将唐当做人贩给围了。
“也就是说，唐，你一个人救下了夜间被绑的妇女们，制服两名歹徒，并找到了关键人物？”骑士小队长问唐。
“还有姆莉，她以身入局寻找人贩老巢，可惜被我破坏了，不过应该能从其他人贩口中问出地点。”唐指向身边的姆莉。
闻言，姆莉心中一惊，然后尴尬地用手扣着泛红的面颊，没好意思解释自己也是被绑架的一员。
小队长点头，嘱咐妇女们悄悄回家，不要声张，而后带上唐与姆莉还有一干骑士悄悄包围了花店。
在抓人前，他们还要确认一下花店老板的身份，于是让一位年轻的骑士进店买花，其他人则悄悄观察。
那骑士推门而入，好奇地左顾右盼装作顾客，却还是吓到了那位店长。
“骑士先生？您是来买花的？”店长脸上的笑容有些僵硬。

Chapter 5 Knights and Knights
Tang was most likely not a human trafficker, so who was he being targeted by?
After thinking about it, Muli decided that the only person who could be suspicious was the flower shop manager.
But can someone as good as the store manager be a bad person? Muli didn't want to believe it, but the store manager gave her a pot of spiritual box, which was exactly what Tang said before about sending flowers...
"Tang, how did you find us?" Muli took the opportunity to ask Tang.
"Oh? It's all thanks to this guy." Tang pointed to the black dog following at his feet. At this time, the opponent seemed to have won a great victory and was walking proudly.
Tang began to explain his actions during this period:
Through continuous investigation, it was found that the missing persons had received flowers from others. When they informed the Knights of the matter, there was no investigation result. Instead, they were warned by the Knights not to lie about the clues.
So he took it upon himself to give flowers in the name of confession in order to find clues. Later, it was discovered that the women who had received flowers with strong scent coverage were not kidnapped.
"After many attempts, I confirmed the matter and found a dog trainer in the town. I happened to hear that people often rent hunting dogs during this period."
Mu Li was shocked after hearing this. Was this the reason why Tang sent flowers to express his love? Isn’t it really about courtship?
"Uh...so, your confession has never been successful?"
"It was successful, but I regretted it and hurt people's self-esteem. I still have to explain it to them later."
"In other words, you have never thought about finding a lover?" Muli felt that she was a bit gossipy.
"How could it be? To become the greatest knight, you must have a lover, but I don't want to encounter love in this way." Tang explained that although his confession was false, he wanted his lover to be true.
Muli didn't know how to comment for a moment, so she brought the topic back.
"How did you find us with a hound?"
"It ran away and sniffed the spirit box at the door of the flower shop. When it saw me coming, it turned around and led me to chase it here."
Tang's tone was casual and direct, but Muli broke out in a cold sweat.
Spirit box? Is that gentle store manager really a human trafficker? ! Fortunately, I met Tang...
"Spirit box? Are you talking about that radiant flower?" A girl interrupted the conversation.
"Someone also gave me the same flowers!" A woman was surprised.
"We will report that person to the Knights when we get back!"
"Yes! It's so abominable!"
Soon after returning to the town, the women were surrounded by a large number of knights before they entered the town gate, and Mli was so frightened that she quickly explained.
It turned out that someone discovered that they were missing in the middle of the night and reported it to the Knights. The Knights had been looking for Tianming. They were excited and exhausted at the moment. They were confused and thought Tang was a human trafficker.
"That is to say, Tang, you single-handedly rescued the women who were kidnapped at night, subdued the two gangsters, and found the key person?" the knight squad leader asked Tang.
"There is also Muli. She entered the game to find the human traffickers' lair. Unfortunately, I destroyed it, but she should be able to find out the location from other traffickers." Tang pointed to Muli beside him.
Hearing this, Muli was startled, and then awkwardly pressed her hands on her red cheeks, not embarrassed to explain that she was also one of the kidnapped people.
The squad leader nodded and told the women to go home quietly without making any noise. Then he took Tang, Muli and a group of knights to quietly surround the flower shop.
Before arresting someone, they also wanted to confirm the identity of the flower shop owner, so they asked a young knight to enter the shop to buy flowers while the others quietly observed.
The knight pushed open the door and entered, looking around curiously and pretending to be a customer, but he still frightened the store manager.
"Mr. Knight? Are you here to buy flowers?" The smile on the store manager's face was a little stiff.
